implementation_scope.family: Inspect streamed Log revisions without waiting for unlimited history to finish
implementation_scope.change: Native loaded-row selection, keyboard navigation and read-only comparisons work while history continues; stable selected hashes and details survive later prefixes and final publication.
implementation_scope.ownership: Cancel or failed refresh restores stable rows and a still-valid user selection; stale rendered-row actions and closed-owner replies are refused; repository mutation controls stay blocked during history loading.
implementation_scope.rendering: Bound automatic column sizing to a prefix and visible rows, preserve full-range explicit fitting and user-adjusted widths, and avoid rebuilding every row signature on progress updates.
implementation_scope.history_default: Pinned upstream No limitation default retained; no arbitrary history cap introduced.

focused_validation_scope.repository: Private actual 258-commit repository with notes metadata holds after 128 and 256 rows.
native_inputs: Native NSTableView selection delegate and arrow keys
Native changed-file selection and shared SwiftUI primary handler
assertions: Rendered message and changed-file details while loadingHistory
Selected commit/details retained across 256-row prefix and final 258 rows
Real held second refresh cancellation and owner close drain
Owned receivers and held Git helpers reaped
focused_validation_scope.fixture_only_repairs: Early attempts lacked an actual notes reference for the hold, then used incorrect NSView hit-test coordinate space; private notes setup and parent-space conversion were repaired without removing assertions.
focused_validation_scope.boundary: Native selector and shared-handler acceptance does not prove physical mouse gestures, signed user-repository selection or every Log workflow.

normal_startup.cache_state: Warm filesystem; one cold application-process sample, not a cache-cold benchmark.

quit.owned_windows: All owned main-process windows disposed by process exit.

child_close.individual_child_close_outcome: Not independently established before normal Quit; the timeout is not classified as a product close failure.

log_selection.measurement_boundary: One actual Finder/Log pointer-selection and read-only comparison observation while history was still loading. No Log latency measurement or new Commit timing was performed.

follow_on.scope: Displayed commits and changed files were inspected while the actual user history continued streaming, and an actual changed-file double-click opened the correct read-only parent/selected comparison. Every Log command and mutation pipeline remain separate acceptance scope.
follow_on.commit_timing: Build25 timing evidence is inherited only; not repeated for build26.

limitations: The signed owned application components target arm64 local testing; universal runtime representatives do not establish Intel application compatibility.
Prior runtime helper execution evidence is inherited, not repeated for this consolidation.
